card.name: Inside adenosine and guanosine names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of nucleoside names, such as the "enos" in adenosine, "os" in S-adenosyl, "any" in guanylyltransferase and "ine" in guanosine. It appears in drug and biochemistry text.

modes.label: Adenosine
modes.description: The piece after "ad" or "aden" while the word adenosine or S-adenosyl is being spelled out.

modes.label: Guanosine/guanyl
modes.description: The middle or ending piece of guanosine or guanylyl words.

card.plain: It fires partway through the names adenosine and guanosine, as the word is being spelled out.
